choose.title: Restore local OCF access
choose.description: The local OCF credential for {name} is missing, invalid or no longer authorized. Import your saved credential in the existing entry options. If local storage is damaged, back up the credential first, then use Forget local OCF credential and import again. This does not require Samsung OAuth reauthentication. Working RPC and Cloud controls are unaffected.

abort.reconfigure: Continue in the local credential import form.

choose.title: Choose how to resolve the Cloud issue
choose.description:
SmartThings authorization for {name} is missing, expired or revoked. Reconnect the account, or switch this existing entry to Local only. In Hybrid, reachable LAN controls continue to work; cloud-only controls are unavailable.

For {name}, open the existing entry options to change control mode, or reconnect the account when authorization is invalid. Local-only setup verifies the soundbar host and identity before saving; device and entity IDs are preserved.

abort.reconfigure: Continue in the selected configuration flow. The issue remains until Cloud recovers or Local only is saved.
abort.repair_flow_unavailable: The configuration flow could not be opened. Open the integration options from Settings > Devices & services.

You can switch this existing entry to Local only. Reachable LAN controls in Hybrid remain available.

application_credentials.description: Create a SmartThings OAuth-In App with the SmartThings CLI. Add this redirect URI exactly: `{redirect_uri}`. Use scopes `r:devices:*`, `x:devices:*`, and `r:locations:*`. Do not add `sse`: SmartThings does not expose it to user-created OAuth-In apps. Then enter the generated client ID and client secret here. [SmartThings CLI documentation]({console_url})
